feature_name: Folders for BigQuery Studio code assets
summary: Folders can organize and control access to single-file code assets such as notebooks, saved queries, data canvases, and data preparation files.
extended_definition: Folders can organize and control access to single-file code assets such as notebooks, saved queries, data canvases, and data preparation files.

supporting_pages.title: Organize code assets with folders \_|\_ BigQuery \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Organize code assets with folders You can access and organize your code assets by using folders in the Files pane of BigQuery Studio: A folder is the basic container for organizing code assets, similar to a standard file system folder.
Organize code assets with folders Preview This feature is subject to the "Pre-GA Offerings Terms" in the General Service Terms section of the Service Specific Terms .
Folders offer Identity and Access Management (IAM) policy inheritance, which you can use to control access to code assets more efficiently.

supporting_pages.title: Explore BigQuery in the Google Cloud console \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Files tab of the left pane ( Preview ): use the Files tab to organize code assets such as saved queries and notebooks by using folders.
The Files tab lets you create user and team folders that store and organize your code assets.
For more information, see Organize code assets with folders .
